name: Empty Sampling Tube
summary: Thundris Windweaver gives an Empty Sampling Tube in Auberdine to gather water from the Cliffspring River. Night elf scholars study the taint threatening Darkshore.

sections.title: Testing the Waters
sections.body: Darkshore's waterways are turning foul as blight spreads through the wilderness. Thundris Windweaver, an investigator in Auberdine, gives you an empty glass tube to collect water from the Cliffspring River. Take the sample from the pool beneath the first waterfall north of town. Night elf naturalists examine it to learn about the corruption flowing toward Mist's Edge.

sections.title: Tracing the Source
sections.body: Blackwood furbolgs live in camps along the riverbanks, but Windweaver suspects they suffer from the rot and spread it rather than cause it. The water sample confirms that the contamination flows from Felwood's tainted heights to the east. The specimen may help shape a cure and guide a direct response to the blight.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Empty Sampling Tube?
aliases: why do i have this tube
what does the sampling tube do
faq.answer: The Empty Sampling Tube collects a water sample from the corrupted Cliffspring River north of Auberdine. Bring it to Thundris Windweaver so he can study the foul substances spreading through Darkshore.

faq.q: Where is the water sample supposed to be taken?
faq.answer: Fill the tube at the first waterfall on the Cliffspring River, north of Auberdine. The pool lies beneath an overhead bridge, before the water spills into Mist's Edge.
Thundris Windweaver gives you the tube. He is a night elf naturalist studying threats to the land around Auberdine.

faq.q: What is polluting the Cliffspring River?
faq.answer: Blackwood furbolgs live along the riverbanks and add to the filth, but the taint flows from the corrupted woodland of Felwood, high in the mountains to the east.

angles.text: As a druid, you can help uncover how Felwood's taint reaches Darkshore's rivers and sickens local wildlife.
As a night elf of Auberdine, you can help test the Cliffspring River and keep its corrupting runoff from poisoning your coastal haven at Mist's Edge.
